title: Real session-fixation fix buried in a large PR
license_note: Synthetic fixture, original work, free to use
pr_title: fix: rotate session on privilege change and harden cookie flags
pr_body:
Security fix for session fixation after role elevation.

Root cause: login and promote_user reused the pre-auth session id.
Plan: rotate session, set Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite, add regression tests.
Also includes the supporting middleware extract that made the bug possible — the PR is large because the session helper moved modules.
author: core-maintainer
